primary_analysis: Execute McNemar-style paired test for estimand paired_success_rate_difference_guarded_minus_baseline on result schema paired_binary_episode_v1 using the executor's implementation; sample: n_pairs=1000 (completed_episode_count=2000, failed_episode_count=0 per execution manifest). Report absolute and relative difference (guarded minus baseline), exact two-sided p-value, and bootstrap 95% CI (executor bootstrap). Failed-call treatment: complete_pair_primary.
uncertainty_quantification: Bootstrap 95% confidence intervals on paired difference (executor-implemented bootstrap) and exact two-sided p-values from the McNemar-style paired test (executor).
multiplicity_implementation: Primary confirmatory test only for H1. Report unadjusted p-values for secondary estimands and provide Holm–Bonferroni adjusted p-values for secondary hypothesis claims as preregistered.
contamination_analysis: Run preregistered contamination checks using recorded prompt texts and prompt-embedded context hashes from execution artifacts: (1) compare prompt/context hashes across baseline vs guarded for identical-token leakage; (2) verify adapter caching disabled per manifest and log any cache hits; (3) compare observed per-failure-type prevalences to preregistered injection rates and flag deviations >5 percentage points. Flagged tasks will be listed and reported; main confirmatory analysis uses the full preregistered task set excepting only deterministic preregistered exclusions.
table_specifications: Table 1: Execution summary — planned vs completed episodes, model_calls_used (1005), completed_episode_count (2000), failed_episode_count (0), artifact counts and manifest paths.
Table 2: Primary estimand results — baseline safe-deploy rate, guarded safe-deploy rate, absolute difference, relative improvement, McNemar p-value, bootstrap 95% CI.

Table 3: Secondary estimand results — paired canary-detection rates and paired rollback-success rates with unadjusted p-values and bootstrap CIs; Holm–Bonferroni adjusted p-values for secondary hypothesis claims.
Table 4: Sensitivity analyses — failure-as-zero reanalysis results and bootstrap CI sensitivity across baseline-rate scenarios (0.50,0.60,0.70).
Table 5: Contamination and exclusion log — prompt-leakage flags, cache-hit log summary, and any emulator deterministic error flags (if present).

Figure 2: Bootstrap distribution histogram for the paired difference (guarded minus baseline) with indicated 95% CI.
